Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: measured 2D puppet LEFT sleeve extraction from an exact front-view tracing template, not a new costume design.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY EDIT TARGET: an 800x1200 measured crop from the original front reference. Its geometry is binding. Image 2 is the full character turnaround only for confirming costume identity and small hidden shoulder details. Do not use or invent a different sleeve design.
Output a standalone sleeve+hand on the SAME 800:1200 portrait canvas and the SAME NORMALIZED POSITIONS as image 1, preferably exactly 800x1200. Extract and faithfully clean up the viewer-LEFT sleeve and its small relaxed hand. Remove ALL hoodie torso, chest, strap, hood, skirt, other body parts, white background and horizontal reference guide lines. Only complete the small shoulder cap hidden by the strap; retain the exact rest of the sleeve silhouette, fold positions, cuff and pose.
MEASURED GEOMETRY — critical:
Shoulder attachment center is [704,84] in the 800x1200 template, normalized [.880,.070].
Wrist skin/cuff junction center is [196,1028], normalized [.245,.85667].
The shoulder-to-wrist straight-line length is about 1072 template pixels. Keep this full length; do not shrink the whole sleeve.
The sleeve has the reference's narrower, modestly loose silhouette. Preserve its elbow and forearm widths, avoiding a huge round balloon:
at 70% along shoulder→wrist, transverse width perpendicular to that line is 312 template pixels (0.291 of arm length);
at 75%, width is 337 pixels (0.314 of arm length);
at 80%, width is 321 pixels (0.299 of arm length);
at 85%, width is 263 pixels (0.245 of arm length).
These widths are the intended cloth silhouette, not measuring guides to draw. The broadest forearm is only about 31.4% of shoulder–wrist length.
Trace the PRIMARY template edges as closely as possible: its upper arm is relatively slim, elbow falls naturally along the long diagonal, forearm has only a modest soft puff, and fabric narrows into the compact cuff. Do not broaden forearm, shorten arm, rotate limb, exaggerate puffiness, enlarge cuff, or move the shoulder/wrist.
Match the reference's pale cyan/mint and lilac fabric, soft pastel shading and fine plum colored outline, same asymmetric purple sleeve stripes, outlined geometric sleeve mark and pastel pixel patches at the same relative positions. This is a faithful cleaned-up layer from the template, not a restyled glossy garment.
HAND: keep the reference hand's small scale, relaxed down-left angle, and wrist position. It must have exactly FOUR non-thumb fingers plus ONE thumb, five digits total, with each fingertip legible and no extra sliver tip. Subtle small natural relaxed fingers, no elongated fashion fingers. Natural unpainted nails only, no colored polish or white manicure tips. Plain purple/lilac fabric cuff only: NO wrist display, watch or jewelry.
BACKGROUND: actual transparent PNG alpha if supported. If this image path cannot encode true alpha, use one perfectly flat saturated chroma-green background near RGB 18,240,14 (#12F00E) instead. NEVER draw a checkerboard or fake transparency preview. No shadows, gradients, text, labels, borders, guide lines or extra objects. All intended sleeve and hand edges fully inside canvas, with the template's existing margins.
